universe: All 12 frozen 2021 CPI releases from the existing BLS manifest.

source_hierarchy.source_family: Danske Bank issue-specific static research PDF
source_hierarchy.rule: Use existing qualifying 4/4 record from the latest pre-T0 issue when available.

source_hierarchy.source_family: TeleTrade historical daily Schedule for today
source_hierarchy.rule: Only when priority-1 is unavailable/incomplete. Use the schedule article published strictly before T0 and require all four CPI forecast rows from that same article.

teletrade_required_fields.core_mom: U.S. CPI excluding food and energy, m/m
teletrade_required_fields.core_yoy: U.S. CPI excluding food and energy, Y/Y

teletrade_clock_rule: Use the already-adjudicated 2021 TeleTrade historical market-news clock as GMT, established by same-feed release-time alignment in the NFP technical amendment.
timestamp_rule: TeleTrade article publication clock must be strictly before the frozen BLS T0. Equality fails.
version_rule: Preserve stable article identity, URL, publication timestamp, retrieval time and content hash.
conflict_rule: No averaging. Higher-priority qualifying source wins. Lower-priority evidence may be logged but cannot replace a complete priority-1 record.
missing_rule: Any missing one of the four required fields leaves the event incomplete.
note: Frozen after the Reuters fallback attempt failed to establish enough field-complete pre-T0 coverage and before running a TeleTrade CPI census.
